reason: The native DuButton and four mapped token consumers are real, but the five-token runtime closure is incomplete and #5854FF expands beyond its approved navigation-current role.

blockers.finding: The Dango root declares background: var(--du-bg-2), but computed background is black with a pitch-black remote texture because the later generic .source-schema-demo rule overrides it. A declaration that loses the cascade is not runtime consumption.

#5854FF correctly drives the current navigation cue and does not contaminate --du-primary-*, but it is also hardcoded into Beta, import/code/table and checklist affordances. The approved role is documentation current-page cue only, so this is unsupported role expansion.

passes: All five declared --du-* targets exist in the DangoUI catalog.
--du-bg-1, --du-text-1, --du-border-1 and --du-primary-solid-bg resolve to expected values on real Dango consumers.
The Button page contains real DuButton runtime instances with genuine component classes and the --du-bt-solid-bg to --du-primary-solid-bg chain.
32px height, 4px radius, #7C66FF fill, focus, activated state and blur restoration are preserved; hover/active stability is also present in the scoped source rule.
NavigationBar remains composition-candidate and is not claimed as a runtime instance.
Documentation shell, technical flow and page outline remain style-only compositions without invented component/API claims.
The held-out release checklist reuses the same scope/tokens and a native DuButton with changed information structure.
